mapper.select: SELECT id, base_url as baseUrl, api_key as apiKey, model, embedding_model as embeddingModel, embedding_dimensions as embeddingDimensions, supports_embedding as supportsEmbedding, temperature, is_default as isDefault, is_default_embedding as isDefaultEmbedding, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM llm_provider_config ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, base_url as baseUrl, api_key as apiKey, model, embedding_model as embeddingModel, embedding_dimensions as embeddingDimensions, supports_embedding as supportsEmbedding, temperature, is_default as isDefault, is_default_embedding as isDefaultEmbedding, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM llm_provider_config WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_provider_config ( id, base_url, api_key, model, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, supports_embedding, temperature, is_default, is_default_embedding, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{model}, #{embeddingModel}, #{embeddingDimensions}, COALESCE(#{supportsEmbedding}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{temperature}, 0.2), COALESCE(#{isDefault}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{isDefaultEmbedding}, FALSE), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE llm_provider_config SET base_url = #{baseUrl}, api_key = #{apiKey}, model = #{model}, embedding_model = #{embeddingModel}, embedding_dimensions = #{embeddingDimensions}, supports_embedding = #{supportsEmbedding}, temperature = #{temperature}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE llm_provider_config SET is_default = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE llm_provider_config SET is_default = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE llm_provider_config SET is_default_embedding = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE llm_provider_config SET is_default_embedding = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
